estimate.formula: 96 * [min, max] of observed complete 5-epoch proxy durations
assumptions: One seed, 24 ports, four fresh arms per port, five epochs each, serial execution.
New arms have comparable data sizes, batch size, model and hardware to the proxies.
CE/hard/repair/repair_raw are timing proxies, not measurements of the new 2x2 cells.
The empirical min/max envelope is not a confidence interval or guaranteed bound.
No scaling by sample count or optimizer steps; absent fields stay null.
No teacher retraining, prerequisite work, queue wait or unmeasured overhead is included.
Missing or unfinished observations are omitted, never assigned zero duration.

measurement_scope.walltime: curve.json seconds sums all five epochs, including source validation and best-state CPU copy.
measurement_scope.excluded_walltime: Startup, data loading before epochs, checkpoint I/O, final inference/export, queue wait and retries are unmeasured.
measurement_scope.cpu: No process CPU duration is recorded. Host perf_counter elapsed time is walltime, not CPU time.
measurement_scope.gpu: No CUDA-event duration, utilization integral or energy is recorded; GPU compute time cannot be inferred.
measurement_scope.resources: resources.json is a preflight snapshot; free_mb and process listings are not duration or peak-memory measurements.
measurement_scope.steps: training.optimizer_steps and curve.steps are observed; curve.steps is cumulative, so it is not summed.
measurement_scope.samples: fit_n and validation_n come only from training.json; no labels or predictions are read.
measurement_scope.batch_size: Not a training.json/curve.json field; no per-run observed batch size is invented.
measurement_scope.completion: Require fold_artifacts_verified, arm training_completed=true, exit_code=0 and a five-epoch training summary; no artifact hashes are computed or checked.
measurement_scope.timing_source: pixel_correction_research/train_pixels.py: train_arm epoch timer before minibatches and after source validation; confirmed against pilot_v1/frozen_code/train_pixels.py.
